text.tspan: Passionate, engaged employees are an important
part of what makes Amazon successful. We

investing in the physical, mental, and emotional
well-being of our employees is a top priority. To
achieve this ambition and ensure our workforce
has the tools and support they need to succeed,
we invest in our employees and their futures

programs are equitable, empowering all employees
